$Comment: The binding row for the shipped Zc_Encounter_Example script: what the server owes for that
fight, which the script itself never describes. Copy this beside your own script and change
Every group is optional and every leaf can be left out, so write only what you want to differ
from the defaults. Subject names the script's own target slot the boss is bound into. Scale grows
the boss's maximum health with the party (HealthPerMember 0.35 makes a four-member fight 2.05
times the health) and with a companion's power reading. Timing guards the run from outside:
how long an empty arena counts as a wipe, how long a run may last at most. Loot.OnDefeat is
rolled per credited participant and scaled by their share; Loot.OnPhase, keyed by the script's
state name, drops on the ground at the boss. Feedback names the FeedbackMoment fired at each
beat. Discovery puts a world-map marker over the boss while the fight is on.
Switch the whole binding off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounters.json
under the key zc_encounter_example, and the library neither binds, scales nor pays this script.
